BEGINNING at the intersection of the Southeasterly line of Redman Avenue (60.00 feet wide) with the Southwesterly line of Turnley Avenue (20.00 feet wide, also known as Veterans Lane); thence

(1.) Along the Southwesterly line of Turnley Avenue, South 44 degrees 49 minutes 50 seconds East, a distance of 140.00 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 2 and 3, Block 129, Tax Map; thence

(2.) Along said division line, South 45 degrees 00 minutes 00 seconds West, a distance of 100.00 feet to an angle point; thence

(3.) Continuing along said division line, North 44 degrees 49 minutes 50 seconds West, a distance of 140.00 feet to a point in the Southeasterly line of Redman Avenue; thence

(4.) Along the Southeasterly line of Redman Avenue, North 45 degrees 00 minutes 00 seconds East, a distance of 100.00 feet to the point and place of beginning.

BEING Lot 2, Block 129, Tax Map.

BEING COMMONLY KNOWN AS 20 E. Redman Avenue, Haddonfield, NJ.
